metadata.title: AMD Stock: CPU Competition Gearing Up to Cool Massive Run<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
CPU Competition Gearing Up to Cool AMD’s Massive Run
Advanced Micro Devices has soared over the past year amid excitement over its central-processing units. But the stock might be due for a pause, according to analysts at William Blair.
